title: Shifting operators in geometric quantization
abstract: In a series of papers on Bohr-Sommerfeld-Heisenberg quantization of completely integrable systems we interpreted shifting operators as quantization of functions ${\mathrm{e}}^{ \pm iθ_j}$ , where $(I_j , θ_j )$ are action angle coordinates. The aim of this paper is to show how these operators occur in geometric quantization.
